limitations: P1 — Counterevidence: Poisson and regular offspring do concentrate after division by d. A mixture Gaussian contraction may repair the general theorem.
P2 — Counterevidence: Eq138 has correct factor. Independent exact Eq135 and h coefficient expansion matches; h(.0612)=-.02705625426. Floating quadrature supports g4<s but is not a grid certificate.
P3 — Counterevidence: Potential iid messages independent of gamma restore intended identities without changing actual first gamma branches.

P5 — Counterevidence: Later Eq105 agrees with Eq106 and d-star criterion used in proof.
P6 — Counterevidence: Formal threshold inequality remains true; for d>=(q-1)^2 the KS point is admissible.
P7 — Counterevidence: Correct tail-index replacement and missing constant yield standard Lindeberg O(D^-1/2) remainder.
P8 — Counterevidence: Intended two-point/weak-recovery equivalence uses distinct vertices.

p0=P(gamma=0)>0, lambda nonzero, x_n>0; includes Poisson offspring.

Recorded check: antiferromagnetic threshold interpretation

Poisson d2, q4, all admissible lambda in[-1/3,0).

Recorded check: Appendix A replacement variables

Independent bounded increments Vj, matching independent Gaussian Zj, C3 function with bounded derivatives.

Recorded check: distinct vertices in Corollary 1.6

q3or4 large d,d lambda^2<=1; vertices allowed equal literally.

repair.content:
Center at gamma*x_n/d; retain offspring mixture, or strengthen to X_d/d->1 with uniform integrability.

Restore normalization and rerun rigorous grid with error/rounding certificate; use cube complement exterior domain.

Define all potential child messages independent of gamma; qualify strict positivity by nonempty observed level.

Replace printed argument with conditional variance monotonicity and Cauchy-Schwarz.

Correct Eq15 bracket by factor4.

Separate vacuous domain range and restrict existence interpretation to admissible KS neighbourhood.

Sk=sum_(j<k)Vj+sum_(j>=k)Zj; Tk=sum_(j<k)Vj+sum_(j>k)Zj. Subtract Ephi(Tk), correct Frobenius norm square.

Require u!=v.
